summary:

description.en:
R2 is Robbyant’s wheeled humanoid platform for indoor manipulation. It combines an omnidirectional base with articulated arms, joint-torque feedback and six-axis end-effector force sensing. Robbyant describes a reach from floor level to two metres and a rated 6 kg payload per arm.

The design includes joint brakes, compliant grasping and swappable dual batteries. The manufacturer reports approximately four hours of runtime, with dock charging offered as an option. The official product page marks R2 as coming soon and positions it for validating robot models and integrated task solutions in real indoor settings.
